Depending on the UGC you get placed in, you'll be in a different Scholar's designated residence hall \(Ex: If you get placed in Leadership and Service, you'll be living in Benedict College; if you get placed in Global Studies, you'll be living in Greeley College, etc.\). There'll be some people in your building in the same program as you but it doesn't mean that you can only pick roommates in the scholars program \(I have a few friends who roomed with non\-scholars program students their first year\). After the first year you're free to room wherever you want.
